qualitative.gate_2_reason: Speculative commodity price-taker (silver/gold mining) with 100% of mining operations in Mexico subject to regulatory and security risks.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Rejected – G2 Essential Need). World's largest primary silver producer, but an unhedged commodity price-taker with 100% of mining operations located in Mexico. Faces substantial Mexican mining-law reform risks, water permitting hurdles, and cartel security issues, with majority ownership (~75%) held by Industrias Peñoles.
qualitative.evidence: Fresnillo produces silver and gold across Mexican underground and open-pit mines. Operating profits fluctuate directly with COMEX/LBMA bullion spot prices, with no independent pricing power. Mining operations in Zacatecas and Sonora face operational disruption risks and escalating regulatory burdens in Mexico.
